data.desc: AXIL Brands (NYSE American: AXIL) is an emerging global consumer products company. The Company is a manufacturer and marketer of premium hearing enhancement and protection products, including ear plugs, earmuffs, and ear buds, under the AXIL brand, premium hair and skincare products under its in-house Reviv3 brand - selling products in the United States, Canada, the European Union, and throughout Asia and provides marketing services to third-party brands.
